notes: Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/ECON-ug.html. All major courses (including electives) must be passed with C- or better; minimum 2.0 major GPA. B.S. adds ECON 5, a full three-quarter intermediate micro sequence (100A-B-C), and requires at least two electives from an advanced list. Total 15 courses minimum.

buckets.label: Calculus sequence (complete one full sequence)
buckets.note: Complete either MATH 10A-B-C or MATH 20A-B-C (20-series recommended). Do not mix sequences.

buckets.label: Principles of Economics and Data Analytics
buckets.note: ECON 1, ECON 3, and ECON 5 (data analytics for the social sciences; ECON 5 = POLI 5), all required.

buckets.label: Intermediate Microeconomics
buckets.note: Full three-quarter sequence for the B.S.

buckets.label: Upper-division economics electives
buckets.note: Five additional upper-division economics electives, at least two of which must come from the advanced electives list: ECON 101, 103, 105, 106, 109, 111, 112, 113, 117, 121, 122, 125, 129, 134, 136, 137, 141, 142, 143, 146, 150, 151, 152, 171, 172, 173, 174, 176, 178, 182, 183, 190, or MATH 194. Advanced list verified against catalog.
